plugins.name: contextstellar
plugins.description: Context engineering plugin for Claude Code — real-time prompt scoring, RLM adaptive weights, and token optimization. Scores every tool use across 5 dimensions (token utilization, structural clarity, specificity, content density, cache-friendliness) and learns optimal weights for your project.

skills.name: optimize
skills.description: Analyze recent prompt patterns and suggest optimizations. Use when the user wants to improve their prompting patterns, reduce token costs, or see what the RLM flywheel has learned about their project.
skills.description_zh: 分析近期提示使用模式并提出优化建议，帮助改进提示、降低令牌成本，查看RLM循环对项目积累的学习结果。

skills.name: score
skills.description: Score a prompt for context engineering quality. Use when the user asks to score, analyze, or optimize a prompt, or when reviewing prompt quality before sending to an LLM.
skills.description_zh: 评估提示的上下文工程质量，支持评分、分析、优化及发送给大模型前的质量审查。

skills.name: setup
skills.description: Set up ContextStellar cloud mode for RLM learning and dashboards. Use when the user wants to configure an API key, connect their project, or upgrade from local-only scoring.
headings: Optional: custom instance URL (defaults to https://contextstellar.com)
skills.description_zh: 配置ContextStellar云模式以支持RLM学习和仪表板，包括API密钥、项目连接及从仅本地评分升级。

skills.name: stats
skills.description: Show ContextStellar scoring statistics, RLM learning progress, and grade distribution for the current project. Use when the user asks about their scoring stats, prompt quality trends, or RLM weight learning.
skills.description_zh: 显示当前项目的ContextStellar评分统计、等级分布与RLM学习进展，分析提示质量趋势和权重学习。
